about.description: We're an architectural asphalt shingle specialist based in Great Falls, Montana. Owned and operated by Max Poitra, we deliver honest workmanship, quality materials, and roofing systems built to endure Montana weather. One roofer. One standard. No runaround.

image.alt: Max Quality Roofing crew on a residential roof

description: Max Quality Roofing was founded on a simple belief: a roof is only as good as the person who installs it. Max Poitra is an architectural asphalt shingle specialist who built this company on honest work, quality materials, and a refusal to cut corners. No subcontractor roulette. No high-pressure sales tactics. Just a shingle master doing the job right — the first time.

Based in Great Falls, Montana, Max Quality Roofing serves homeowners and businesses across the surrounding communities. From full roof replacement and architectural asphalt shingle installations to leak repair and preventative maintenance, every project is handled personally by Max and his crew. Montana weather doesn't forgive a poorly installed roof — so we build every roof to endure heavy snow, wind, hail, and temperature swings.

Today, Max Quality Roofing stands for one thing above all else: craftsmanship. If your roof needs replacing, repairing, or a professional opinion, you'll get a straight answer and a fair price. Because at the end of the day, quality isn't a marketing word — it's the only way we do business.

section.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
section.description: Straight answers about our roofing services in Great Falls, Montana.

items.question: What kind of roofing do you specialize in?
items.answer: Max Quality Roofing specializes in architectural asphalt shingle roofing. Max Poitra is a shingle master with years of experience installing high-quality shingle systems built to endure Montana weather.

items.question: Do you do full roof replacements?
items.answer: Yes. We handle complete roof replacements including full tear-off down to the decking, replacement of damaged plywood, and installation of a brand-new roofing system.

items.question: Do you repair roof leaks?
items.answer: Yes. We offer leak detection, flashing repair, and preventative maintenance. If you have an active leak, call (406) 217-1720 and Max will diagnose it quickly and honestly.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We're based in Great Falls, Montana and serve the surrounding communities. If you're not sure whether we cover your area, just give us a call.

items.question: Are you the owner of the company?
items.answer: Yes. Max Poitra is the owner and operator of Max Quality Roofing. He's personally involved in every project — you talk to the owner, you get the owner's work.

items.question: Do you offer free estimates?
items.answer: Yes. We provide free, no-obligation estimates on every project. Max personally inspects your roof and gives you an honest, written estimate with no hidden fees.

items.question: How fast can you respond?
items.answer: We respond quickly to estimate requests and schedule promptly. If you have an active leak or urgent issue, call (406) 217-1720 and we'll prioritize your request.

items.question: Do you handle both residential and commercial roofs?
items.answer: Yes. We handle residential and commercial roofing projects in Great Falls and surrounding Montana communities — replacements, shingle installations, and repairs.

items.question: What materials do you use?
items.answer: We use quality materials — premium underlayment, architectural asphalt shingles, and proper flashing. No cheap shortcuts. We build roofs that protect your home and last for decades.

items.question: How long does a roof replacement take?
items.answer: Most residential roof replacements are completed in 1-3 days depending on the size and complexity. Max will give you a clear timeline before any work begins.
